name: Xi ma
summary: Xí mà, also called chè mè đen, is black-sesame sweet soup. The 16 Apr 2024 Da Nang page says it came from China and became a Hội An plate: black sesame, sugar, and other ingredients the page does not name. It calls the bowl sweet, rich, and cool.
origin: Hội An, on the 16 Apr 2024 city page. The page names Cụ Thiều’s shoulder pole and does not print a street.
taste: The page calls xí mà sweet, rich, and cool.
howToEat: The page describes sitting by the pot. It does not describe a topping. Check on arrival.
where: Hội An. Cụ Thiều’s shoulder pole is the name on the 16 Apr 2024 page. A street number is not printed. Check on arrival.
The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 7 June 2023 market article names xí mà among local gifts and does not add a recipe.
seoTitle: Xi ma — black-sesame sweet soup in Hoi An
seoDescription: Xí mà is Hội An’s black-sesame sweet soup on Da Nang’s 2024 food page. The page names Cụ Thiều’s shoulder pole and no street. Check on arrival.
